Class SetModelOptions

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.rpc.SetModelOptions
public class SetModelOptions extends Object
Optional settings for a model switch.

All setter methods return this for method chaining. model is required. Every other option is optional; an unset option leaves the corresponding session state unchanged. 

session.setModel(new SetModelOptions().setModel("auto").setAutoTier(AutoTier.INTELLIGENCE)).get();
Since:
1.6.0

    • getAutoTier

    • setAutoTier

      @CopilotExperimental public SetModelOptions setAutoTier(AutoTier autoTier)
      Requests an Auto routing preference alongside the model switch.

      The runtime records the request and commits it only when a later user turn using the auto model successfully obtains a usable model from the provider. Use setResetAutoTier(boolean) to return to the provider's default Auto routing instead.

      Parameters:
      autoTier - the routing preference to request; null to leave the current preference unchanged
      Returns:
      this options object for method chaining

    • isResetAutoTier

      @CopilotExperimental public boolean isResetAutoTier()
      Gets whether the request returns to provider-default Auto routing.
      Returns:
      true when the request clears the Auto routing preference

    • setResetAutoTier

      @CopilotExperimental public SetModelOptions setResetAutoTier(boolean resetAutoTier)
      Requests a return to the provider's default Auto routing.

      This differs from leaving setAutoTier(AutoTier) unset, which keeps the current preference. It cannot be combined with an explicit tier.

      Parameters:
      resetAutoTier - true to return to provider-default Auto routing
      Returns:
      this options object for method chaining
